title: RunResult
description: Unified response for StartRun / ResumeRun / wait-style invokes. Projects LangGraph invoke/stream outcome including __interrupt__ / stream.interrupts. Not a durability store.

status.description: Derived from snapshot interrupts/next/errors. awaiting_approval when interrupt.type is approval; awaiting_input for free-form interrupt types.

output.description: Final graph output values when status is succeeded (or partial values if useful)

interrupts.description: Open interrupts for this thread after the run paused; empty if not interrupted

runtime_state.description: Optional embedded projection; alternatively client calls GetThreadState

messages_preview.description: Optional projection of messages channel for UI; SoR remains checkpointer
